test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **affectionately.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Affectionately**: in a way that displays fondness or tenderness.
 
• The priest **patted** the back of the boy affectionately because, in the next sentence, it is written that if the boy has gotten this much love earlier, he would not have become a thief or criminal.

Hence, the correct answer is **affectionately.**
